title: A study of Sub-Oscillators (and Oscillator Waveshaping)
summary: Survey of sub-oscillator designs in classic synths: CD4013 flip-flop dividers for square waves one or two octaves down (SH-101), pulse variants via diode logic, and how ramp, triangle and sine sub-oscillators are built by mixing divider outputs and waveshaping with rectifiers or soft clipping.
